Synopsis:
US equities closed mixed on Aug 24, 2026 — S&P 500 -0.28%, Nasdaq -0.76%, Dow +0.26%. Tech/semis led declines (NVDA -2.9%, MU -5.8%, AVGO -2.6%) driven by Iran sanctions uncertainty, political headwinds against AI data centers, and pre-earnings caution ahead of Nvidia results. Financials (JPM, Visa) offset losses and held the Dow positive. Bond market stress persists with 30Y yields above 5%, near 19-year highs. Key upcoming catalysts: Nvidia earnings, PCE inflation report (Wednesday), and Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech (Friday). Auto tariffs on Canadian imports escalating to 50% from Jan 1 hit Ford and GM. Markets price in one 25bps rate hike by end of 2026.
